title: Pulsar at ESUG 2026 (new Smalltalk IDE)
summary: Pulsar is a new Smalltalk IDE being introduced at ESUG 2026 (European Smalltalk Users Group conference). Smalltalk is a historic object-oriented programming language known for its integrated development environment paradigm, and Pulsar represents a modern reimagining of the Smalltalk development experience.
problem_solved: Provides a modern development environment for Smalltalk programmers, potentially addressing the gap between classic Smalltalk IDEs and contemporary developer tools.
why_valuable: Revitalizes the Smalltalk ecosystem with a modern IDE, helping attract new developers while serving existing Smalltalk community members who need updated tooling.
